_comment: Index of saved looks. The active one is whichever active.css imports; switch with `npm run preset -- <name>`. Each preset is a token file (see _tokens.md) plus a rules file that Claude reads before building UI. Apps default to dark mode; `mode: auto` presets offer a sun/moon toggle, `mode: dark` presets hide it.

presets.name: clean-light
presets.summary: Neutral, airy, blue primary. The default when no style is requested.

presets.name: bold-dark
presets.summary: Always dark, high contrast, lime accent, tight radii, no shadows.

presets.name: warm-editorial
presets.summary: Cream and ink, terracotta primary, serif headings, hairline borders.

presets.name: aurora-glass
presets.summary: Liquid-glass shell and cards over a slow aurora backdrop; violet, cyan, pink; large radii.

presets.name: card-room
presets.summary: Trick only: green felt backdrop, cream/dark cards, Tenor Sans + DM Sans.
